name: com.requstory/mcp
title: Requstory
description: The index AI agents use to find B2B suppliers, read dated trade facts and request quotes.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Optional. Public tools need no sign-in. Account tools ask the client to sign in with OAuth (discovery at https://requstory.com/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource/mcp); clients without OAuth can send "Bearer rqs_…", a key from the Requstory profile.
